topics.topic: Whether TrialCase `expected_outputs` must exactly match all output ports or may be a subset
questions: When `expected_outputs` is present, must it include exactly all output ports, or can it be a subset?
When `expected_outputs` is present on an authored trial case, must it include exactly all output ports (no missing, no extra), or may it be a subset?

quotes: Either way it is added only when its input values fit the contract version's input ports, its expected outputs, when present, fit the output ports, and every value is within `stored_value_bytes_max` and every file within `trial_fixture_bytes_max` — the first failing condition in this order is named, ports taken in name order and, for one port, presence, carriage, schema, then size.
A case passes when the execution succeeded and, if the case states expected outputs, every output's digest equals the expected one
judgement.why: The rules already require expected outputs (when present) to fit the contract’s output ports and require every output to match an expected value, which excludes subset-only expectations.
